# v1.1.0-dev.53 — Full defect-audit fix pass + new distribution channel

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Rolls up the unreleased `dev.51`
(multi-window match post-restart, VD restore retry) and `dev.52`
(auto-activation hotkey, display-change default off), plus ~60 verified
fixes from a full-codebase defect audit.

## New: downloads + updates now come from dougfessler.com

The source repo is private, so the updater's old GitHub API polling
can't work from user machines. From this release on:

- **Download page:** <https://dougfessler.com/projects/windowlayoutmanager/>
- **Update feed:** the app polls `updates.json` on that page and
  downloads binaries from the public
  [`WindowLayoutManager-releases`](https://github.com/defessler/WindowLayoutManager-releases)
  repo, verifying size + sha256 before installing.

> **One-time manual step:** installs of dev.52 and earlier poll the old
> (now unreachable) GitHub endpoint and will never see this release —
> update by unzipping dev.53 over your install folder once. Auto-update
> resumes from there.

## Fixed — updater

- Downloads are verified against the feed's **sha256 digest and byte
  size** before anything is extracted or executed.
- Network timeouts on metadata and download connections (a stalled
  socket could previously hang the updater forever, wedging
  "install in progress").
- Redirect handling validates every hop (https-only, relative
  `Location` resolved); extraction gets a 3-minute deadline.
- Swap script: literal `%` in install paths no longer breaks cmd.exe;
  robocopy failure retries once and **always relaunches the app**
  (a failed swap can no longer strand you with nothing running).
- Releases without a zip asset are skipped instead of shadowing older
  installable ones.

## Fixed — monitor matching & auto-activation

- "Generic PnP Monitor" device strings (which *every* display reports
  on some machines) no longer count as a distinctive match signal.
- Near-identical monitor bounds now score as a match signal, with a
  contradiction gate so two *different* same-geometry displays don't
  cross-match.
- Monitor-set equality is now tolerance-based (25px) instead of a 50px
  grid snap — sets no longer flicker between "same" and "different"
  when coordinates sit near grid edges.
- Auto-activation: best-guess pairing no longer drops earlier greedy
  assignments; exact-signature sets are preferred over stale ones.

## Fixed — restore correctness

- Minimized windows' saved coordinates are converted from workspace to
  screen space — they no longer restore shifted by the taskbar offset.
- Restoring a minimized window uses `SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE` — Load and the
  re-assert chain no longer steal focus.
- Window matching runs global tier passes: an earlier entry's weak
  process-only claim can no longer steal the exact-title window a
  later entry owned.
- Remapped restores scale DPI from the *source* monitor's saved role.
- Hung windows are skipped instead of blocking the restore pass.
- Explicit Load now releases an active Hold on a different profile
  (they used to fight); pending re-assert chains are cancelled when a
  new load starts; re-asserts skip redundant virtual-desktop calls.

## Fixed — virtual desktops

- All PowerShell interop is now async — desktop queries can no longer
  freeze the UI for seconds at a time.
- Early Windows 11 builds (22000+) are supported via the older
  `IVirtualDesktopManagerInternal` interface shape.
- Desktop-ensure is clamped to 32 desktops.

## Fixed — data safety

- Every settings/profile/blacklist/diagnostics write is atomic
  (temp file + rename) — a crash mid-write can no longer corrupt them.
- Corrupt JSON files are renamed aside (`.corrupt-<ts>`) for recovery
  instead of being silently reset.
- Profile save guards against display-name collisions that map to the
  same file; case-only renames work; stray `.tmp` files are swept.

## Fixed — UI (15 renderer defects)

- Unsaved edits are flushed on *every* profile-switch path (click,
  keyboard nav, filter Enter, external events) — no more silently lost
  tweaks.
- No duplicate undo entries from the window editor's change+blur
  double-fire; re-clicking the selected profile no longer wipes the
  undo stack.
- Live-tracking updates for a *different* profile no longer rebuild
  the editor you're working in mid-edit.
- Modal keyboard isolation: list shortcuts (Enter/Delete/F2) are inert
  under any open modal; Escape consumed by one modal no longer closes
  another; closing the last modal returns focus to the sidebar.
- Welcome wizard and diagnostics-copy prompts read settings correctly
  (they were reading the wrong IPC envelope shape and always fell back
  to defaults).
- Profile filter survives list re-renders; visual-editor j/k ordering
  is stable; failed loads from the keyboard surface an error.

## Fixed — misc

- `wlm://` protocol loads skip the post-load hook, so a hostile web
  page can't chain actions through a drive-by link; scheme matching is
  case-insensitive per RFC 3986.
- Build zip no longer embeds stray working directories
  (`.claude`, `release-assets`, …).
- Jump-list arguments quote profile names safely; hotkey conflict
  probe distinguishes auto-activation vs profile hotkeys correctly.

## Tests

All 12 suites green — 220+ assertions, including new coverage for the
position-confidence tiebreaker and the real companion matcher export.

## Install

Fresh: unzip and run. From dev.52 or earlier: unzip over your install
folder once (see above); auto-update resumes afterwards.
